title: Pre-Staging External HTTP Semantics Readiness Gate
statusRationale: The external HTTP semantics gate is defined, validator-backed, and passing. Both root FQDNs redirect the public JSON proof endpoint from HTTP to same-host HTTPS. Proof/control routes run through repo-owned Netlify Function responses, declare no-store, and show Cloudflare dynamic handling plus Netlify miss/bypass evidence. Low Netlify Age is classified as provider metadata only under the explicit no-store plus miss/bypass no-hit no-stale boundary. Staging-specific enablement may begin; this is not a Staging readiness claim.

cacheProviderDecision.ageMetadataBoundary: Low provider Age is accepted only when proof/control routes declare no-store, Cache-Status has no hit or stale directive, and provider evidence shows miss, bypass, or dynamic handling.

observabilityDecision.boundary: Repository evidence defines correlation, tracing, event, metrics, redaction, and provider/origin boundaries. Provider access-log collection remains a later staging-readiness evidence requirement and is not claimed here.
